notes: Cross-module NUI opener fix. PRC-patched SoU modules use prc_onplayergui as the module OnPlayerGUIEvent script, so the old evn_modgui portrait-click handler could work in one module yet be bypassed in Interlude. 0.8.6.43 overrides prc_onplayergui with an include-free bridge that forwards all GUI events into the existing evn_modgui/EPC path and preserves PRC's stock DurationNUI behavior on effect-icon clicks. This fixes party-portrait opening across PRC modules without changing combat core 0.7.10.7, reader, Plada/FIX5, Dorna AI/profile, or the 0.8.6.42 OnEnter bootstrap.
